# vvcanvas

[![CodeFactor](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/vusaverse/vvcanvas/badge)](https://www.codefactor.io/repository/github/vusaverse/vvcanvas)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/vusaverse/vvcanvas/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/vusaverse/vvcanvas/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![CRAN
status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/vvcanvas)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)
[![The diffify page for the R package
vvcanvas](https://diffify.com/diffify-badge.svg)](https://diffify.com/R/vvcanvas)
[![CRAN last month
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-month/vvcanvas?color=green/)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)
[![CRAN last month
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/vvcanvas?color=green/)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vvcanvas/)

The `vvcanvas` package is an R library that provides a convenient
interface to interact with the Canvas Learning Management System (LMS)
API. It allows users to authenticate, retrieve course information, fetch
specific details, and perform various operations within the Canvas LMS.

## Installation

You can install the `vvcanvas` package from GitHub using the following
command:

    devtools::install_github("vusaverse/vvcanvas")

It is also possible to install from CRAN:

    install.packages("vvcanvas")

## Getting Started

To begin using the `vvcanvas` package, you need to authenticate with the
Canvas LMS API by obtaining an API key and base URL. Follow these steps
to get started:

1.  Acquire an API key from your Canvas LMS instance. You may need to
    consult your Canvas administrator or refer to the Canvas API
    documentation for instructions on obtaining an API key.

2.  Once you have the API key, load the `vvcanvas` library and use the
    `canvas_authenticate` function to authenticate with the Canvas LMS
    API. Provide the API key and the base URL of your Canvas instance as
    parameters. Here’s an example:

``` r
library(vvcanvas)

# Replace the placeholders with your API key and base URL
api_key <- "YOUR_API_KEY"
base_url <- "https://your_canvas_domain.com"

# Authenticate with the Canvas LMS API
canvas <- canvas_authenticate(api_key, base_url)
```

With the authentication step completed, you can now utilize the various
functions provided by the `vvcanvas` package to interact with the Canvas
LMS.

In order to retrieve a dataframe with all courses you can use the
following function:

``` r
# Pass the canvas object to the get_courses function
courses <- get_courses(canvas)
```

# Package index

## Course methods

### Assignment methods.

methods that can be used on assignments in courses.

- [`create_assignment_group()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_assignment_group.md)
  : Create an Assignment Group in Canvas LMS
- [`get_assignment_details()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_assignment_details.md)
  : Get Assignment Details from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_assignment_submissions()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_assignment_submissions.md)
  : Lists assignment submissions for a course.
- [`get_assignments()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_assignments.md)
  : Get Assignments from Canvas LMS API

### Group methods.

methods that can be used on groups in courses.

- [`create_group_category()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_group_category.md)
  : Create a Group Category in Canvas LMS
- [`get_course_groups()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_groups.md)
  : Retrieves the list of groups in a course.
- [`get_group_categories()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_group_categories.md)
  : Get group categories for a context
- [`get_group_info()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_group_info.md)
  : Get information about a single group
- [`get_group_memberships()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_group_memberships.md)
  : Get group memberships
- [`get_group_users()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_group_users.md)
  : Get users in a group

## Analytics methods.

Methods that access Canvas LMS Analytics data.

- [`get_department_participation_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_participation_data.md)
  : Get department-level participation data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_grade_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_grade_data.md)
  : Get department-level grade data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_statistics()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_statistics.md)
  : Get department-level statistics from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_department_statistics_by_subaccount()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_department_statistics_by_subaccount.md)
  : Get department-level statistics by subaccount from the Canvas LMS
  API
- [`get_user_course_participation_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_participation_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level participation data from the Canvas LMS
  API
- [`get_user_course_assignment_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_assignment_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level assignment data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_user_course_messaging_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_user_course_messaging_data.md)
  : Get user-in-a-course-level messaging data from the Canvas LMS API
- [`get_course_participation()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_participation.md)
  : Get course-level participation data from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_student_summaries()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_student_summaries.md)
  : Get student summaries for a course from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_assignment_data()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_assignment_data.md)
  : Get course-level assignment data from the Canvas LMS API

## Other methods.

Methods that need to be indexed.

- [`canvas_authenticate()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/canvas_authenticate.md)
  : Authenticate with Canvas LMS API
- [`create_course_datalake()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_course_datalake.md)
  : Create a data lake for a course.
- [`create_course_section()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_course_section.md)
  : Create a Course Section in Canvas LMS
- [`create_folder()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_folder.md)
  : Create a Folder in Canvas LMS
- [`create_page()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/create_page.md)
  : Create a Page in Canvas LMS
- [`download_course_file()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/download_course_file.md)
  : Downloads a file from a given URL.
- [`get_all_courses()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_all_courses.md)
  : Retrieves a paginated list of all courses visible in the public
  index.
- [`get_course_announcements()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_announcements.md)
  : Retrieves course announcements.
- [`get_course_details()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_details.md)
  : Get Course Details from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_course_enrollments()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_enrollments.md)
  : Retrieves the course enrollments for a course.
- [`get_course_files()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_files.md)
  : Retrieves a list of files within a course.
- [`get_course_folders()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_folders.md)
  : Retrieves course folders.
- [`get_course_pages()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_pages.md)
  : Retrieves the pages within a course.
- [`get_course_quizzes()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_quizzes.md)
  : Retrieves course quizzes.
- [`get_course_sections()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_sections.md)
  : Retrieves course sections.
- [`get_course_students()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_course_students.md)
  : Retrieves the list of students in a course.
- [`get_courses()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_courses.md)
  : Get Courses from Canvas LMS API
- [`get_discussions()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_discussions.md)
  : Retrieves the discussion topics within a course.
- [`get_module_items()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_module_items.md)
  : Retrieves the items within a specific module.
- [`get_modules()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_modules.md)
  : Retrieves the modules within a course.
- [`get_page_content()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_page_content.md)
  : Retrieves the content body of a specified page.
- [`post_new_discussion()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/post_new_discussion.md)
  : Post a New Discussion in Canvas LMS
- [`get_accounts()`](https://vusaverse.github.io/vvcanvas/reference/get_accounts.md)
  : Get a list of accounts from the Canvas LMS API
